entities.summary: Klaudia Tanner is an Austrian politician of the People's Party (ÖVP) who has been serving as the minister of defense in the governments of Chancellors Sebastian Kurz, Alexander Schallenberg, Karl Nehammer, and Christian Stocker since January 2020. From 2011 to 2020, she worked as the General Manager of Austria's political farmers' association.
